description: Adjusts cell references inside formula strings when cells are copied or auto-filled. Relative references (e.g. A1) are moved by the given offset. Absolute references (e.g. $A$1) are preserved. Mixed references ($A1, A$1) adjust only the relative part.

members.name: AdjustCellRef
members.description: Adjusts a single cell reference string (e.g. "$A1", "B$3") by dRow/dCol. Returns "#REF!" if the adjusted position is out of bounds.

members.name: AdjustFormula
members.description: Adjusts all relative cell references in formula by dRow rows and dCol columns. Returns the adjusted formula string, or the original if parsing fails.

members.name: CycleLastAbsoluteRef
members.description: Cycles the absolute/relative mode of the last cell reference in formula through: A1 → $A$1 → A$1 → $A1 → A1. Returns the original formula if no cell reference is found.

members.name: InsertOrReplaceLastRef
members.description: Inserts cellRef into formula: replaces the last CellRef/RangeRef token when present (user picked a new cell), otherwise appends.

members.name: ParseFormulaReferences
members.description: Returns the unique raw cell/range references from formula in order of first appearance. Used to assign highlight colours in formula-point mode.
